lines.en: I go for the weak and the young.
At night, my eyes are bright.
I slip through the leaf litter.

lines.zh: 身体只有一格的三分之一
lines.en: My body is a third of a block wide.
I travel along the tree roots.
My whiskers sweep the tree-root gaps.

lines.zh: 我绕开一块空着的草地
lines.en: I avoid the open grass.

lines.zh: 我藏在灌木影子里移动
lines.en: I move inside the shrub's shadow.
My steps are almost silent.

lines.zh: 夜里的林子，我贴着地面跑。
lines.en: In the night forest, I run low to the ground.
I stop and swivel my ears.

lines.zh: 我的爪子踩在落叶上没声。
lines.en: My paws make no sound on the fallen leaves.
I slip beneath the ferns.
My tail trails low.
I am looking for something weak.
The moonlight does not reach me.
I crouch low.
I listen to the night.
My whiskers are moving.
A little of my teeth shows.
The leaves behind me rustle.

lines.zh: 我一动不动地盯着一个方向
lines.en: I stare at one direction, unmoving.
This is a good ambush spot.
I slowly settle my weight.

lines.zh: 夜风把我的气味吹散了
lines.en: The night wind scatters my scent.
Small as I am, I bite dinosaurs.
I tuck into a very small ball.
I wait for someone else to move first.
Small as I am, I sniff before I bite.
My claw scrapes the earth.
I look up, then lower my head.
Night dew settles on my back.

lines.zh: 你很大,但夜里看不见我
lines.en: You are big, but you cannot see me at night.
I watch you from the shadow.
Your ankles are exposed.
I lift my head, teeth up.
I lift my head to sniff your boot.
I ease a little farther back.
This root is my boundary.
Can I tell that you are tired?

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我的地上
lines.en: Your shadow falls on my ground.
I tilt my head and assess you.
I curl up, claws in the air.
I roll once before I right myself.
This body is too small for such blows.
I burrow into the leaves.
One hind leg will not work.
I curl up and play dead.
Blood runs from my mouth.

lines.zh: 我被踢开，又翻身爬起来。
lines.en: Kicked away, I roll and scramble up.
I retreat under the roots.
I will be more careful.
There is a smell of meat.
I poke out from under the ferns.
That is just enough for me.
I am no plant-eater.
I creep toward the scent.
Do not move your hand.
I have smelled blood.

lines.zh: 这个比我自己找的省事
lines.en: Easier than hunting for myself.
I circle by your feet.
I need only a little.

lines.zh: 我从你靴子边窜进洞里。
lines.en: I dart into a hole beside your boot.

lines.zh: 我从你的脚缝间溜过去
lines.en: I slip between your feet.

lines.zh: 我被你的靴尖挑开，翻了个身。
lines.en: Your boot tip flips me over.
I retreat into the leaves.

lines.zh: 我这么小,撞起来不实在
lines.en: So small, I am hard to hit.
I bite your boot.
Your foot blocks my path.
I dart up the trunk.
We have scattered the leaves.
You should not walk at night.

lines.zh: 我们的毛蹭在一起，很暖。
lines.en: Our fur brushes together, warm.
I press my head to your neck.
No need to go out tonight.
I guard the entrance; you sleep inside.

lines.zh: 我们的皮毛是同样的颜色
lines.en: Our fur is the same colour.
I hear something outside.
Not a single sound.
You stay here.
I will certainly come back.
The burrow is warm.
I pin it with a forepaw.
I cannot eat this.
I carry it into the burrow.
Too small; not nearly enough.
I bite it once and give up.
I hide it under the roots.
It still smells a little of blood.
I drag it slowly.
Who would eat this?
I will put it away safely.
You look weak.
I choose the small and the weak.

lines.zh: 我闻到你腿上的血腥味。
lines.en: I catch the smell of blood on your leg.
I crouch, ready to spring.

lines.zh: 我盯上了你脚边的小动物。
lines.en: I've fixed on the small animal at your feet.

lines.zh: 我只有这具小身体,但牙很利
lines.en: Small as I am, my teeth are sharp.

lines.zh: 我咧开嘴，露出一排细牙。
lines.en: I bare a row of fine teeth.
The roots will slow you.
I count three in my head.

lines.zh: 你听见落叶的声音了吗
lines.en: Did you hear the leaves?
That was my voice just now.
Then let us begin.
I track your ankle.
With every step you take, I am nearer.
In the leaf litter, I am almost silent.

lines.zh: 我躲在蕨叶底下，只露眼睛。
lines.en: I hide under fern leaves, only my eyes showing.
I wait for you to sit down.

lines.zh: 你的靴子太硬,不好下口
lines.en: Your boots are too hard to bite.
I wait for something softer.
The moonlight helps me hide my shadow.
I circle from behind you.
You are walking slower.

lines.zh: 我在树根后面换了个位置。
lines.en: I shift positions behind the roots.
I weave between the roots.
You stop; I wait.
I bite your ankle.
I spring at your calf.
Small teeth, but sharp.
This bite was practiced in the dark.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的后腿往下拖。
lines.en: I bite its hind leg and drag it down.
You kick and throw me off.
I land and roll once.
The taste of blood sharpens my hunger.
I slip from your feet to your back.
I can only bite soft things.
I let go and vanish into the shadow.
I'm not full yet. Stay back.
The leaves move first.
I come out of an earthen burrow.
A small body pressed to the ground.

lines.zh: 我从落叶堆里探出尖鼻子。
lines.en: I poke my pointed snout out of the leaf litter.
I shake the soil off my back.
The night wood belongs to me.
There is something alive nearby.
I creep that way, low to the ground.

lines.zh: 月光下只有一小块影子
lines.en: Only a small shadow in the moonlight.
I disappear among the roots.

lines.zh: 这一片是我常来的地方
lines.en: This is a place I know well.
I make one thin call.
A kin answers from far off.
There will be a kill tonight.
My fur scorches at once.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴断了半截，还在动。
lines.en: Half my tail is broken off, still twitching.
The water closes over me at once.
The blast throws me far.
Something grazes my ribs.

lines.zh: 那道光照得我睁不开眼
lines.en: That light blinds me.
Even my teeth feel weak with hunger.

lines.zh: 雷打得我整条脊背发麻
lines.en: Lightning numbs my whole spine.
No leaves to burrow into here.
